saw_lines: Workers buy safety glasses by the pair, and the same person often buys a second pair for the weekend.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, where buyers decide if the pair suits work or weekend.
Your site offers $10 off a first order, yet 0 of 25 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers $10 off a first order, yet 0 of 25 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer wondering about arrival clicks away. Answer the shipping question in the first line of ads for new buyers, with delivery time.
One exact copy, the Honda CRF450 giveaway, runs in 8 of 25 ads, so the same people see the same opening repeatedly. Keep the copy but change the opening line and creative in each of the 8 ads.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real number, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
